desc: This onyx statuette of a dog can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmMastiff0000000]{Mastiff} for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has Blindsight with a range of 60 feet. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
This item's limited uses represent the 7 days required before the figurine can be used again.
name: onyx dog
